items: 【Smart LED Lights】The wine bar comes with a complimentary LED light strip, adding elegance to your wine display. It offers 250,000 vivid colors and 60 color modes, suiting both cozy gatherings and lively parties. With music/mic sync, the lights dance to the rhythm. You can control it remotely via the app or use the remote for easy adjustment of color modes and on - off control, creating a great atmosphere effortlessly.

【Multipurpose Bar Cabinet】 The mini bar cabinet's unique design, combining rustic charm and a three - sided structure, offers great versatility. It can hold wine glasses, wines, whiskeys, coffee makers and cups. It can function as a bar cabinet, a bar cart, a kitchen storage, a coffee cabinet, a sideboard, etc. It helps keep your space neat and meets all your needs for entertaining friends.

【Spacious Storage Capacity】This wine rack table measures 35.4×30×11.4 inches. It has a large tabletop and five open - style shelves. The open shelf design is versatile. It's great for placing wine glasses, cups, wine bottles, artworks, and can also hold irregular shaped wine bottles, mixology gear, ice buckets, coffee items, etc. It meets your various storage needs, making your space neat and organized.

【Bottle & Glass Storage】This bar table with storage is carefully designed for wine storage. It has 12 compartments for red wine. Storing red wine bottles horizontally helps keep their quality for long - term storage. Besides, it comes with 2 red wine glass holders that can hold 6 glasses, making glass storage convenient and neat. For wine lovers, it's an ideal option.

【User-Friendly Assembly】This home liquor bar features an easy-to-follow instruction and all the parts you need, already numbered for your convenience. With no prior assembly experience required, you can smoothly put it together by simply adhering to the steps. It's truly a hassle-free DIY project that saves you time and effort.
